screens.name: calendar-grid-card

screens.name: tab-indicator-travel
screens.question: Tap between two bottom tabs and watch the pill move. Does it travel as one shape or as two?

screens.name: insights-card-elevation

screens.name: settings-profile-tint
screens.question: Does the tinted panel group the fields, or look like a stray box round them?
